title: Contextual inline error guides and micro-illustrations for rate limits, timeouts, and retry UX
creator: Lena Ortiz
description:
Goal: Create a compact, contextual set of inline error guides ("helplets") and micro-illustrations to live alongside Quickstart and onboarding flows that explain rate limits, request timeouts, and retry behavior. The assets will be used in product screenshots, docs callouts, and the Console onboarding tour. They should be reusable across hosted and dedicated docs, maintain Redwood’s visual system, and be optimized for both light and dark themes.

Scope:
- 3 micro-illustrations (rate-limit cap, timeout clock, smart-retry loop) in 2 color variants (light/dark) and 3 sizes (16px, 32px, 64px).
- 2 inline helplet components: "Quick fix" (short action + link) and "Explain + Learn" (short explainer + docs link).
- 4 annotated product screenshots showing: a throttled API error, a timed-out request in streaming UI, an automatic retry being triggered, and an actionable quick-fix CTA.
- Documentation callout panels for Quickstart and Troubleshooting pages (MDX-ready SVGs + text snippets).
- Accessibility audit checklist for color contrast and screen-reader copy.

Design constraints and considerations: progressive disclosure (show minimal UI by default, expand on hover/click), avoid motion-heavy patterns for accessibility, tie iconography to runtime concepts (tokens, clock, loop), and ensure illustrations scale clearly at small sizes. Images must be optimized for web and included as both SVG and PNG fallbacks.

Deliverables: artboard files (Figma), exported SVG/PNG sets, screenshot PSDs with layered overlays, MDX snippets for docs, and a short usage guide for engineers and writers.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct micro-illustrations exported in SVG and 2 PNG sizes with light and dark variants
Two helplet component specs with copy, states (collapsed/expanded/focus), and accessibility notes
Four annotated screenshots with overlays and source PSDs that match production Console UI styles
MDX callout snippets (copy + example) reviewed by Docs and Product and committed to the docs repo
Design tokens used (colors/spacing/typography) reference Adobe token names and pass contrast checks
